  UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11, away_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal, 'away' FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
),
player_results AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN side = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN side = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
      WHEN side = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN side = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
    END AS result
  FROM player_matches
  WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
player_counts AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'win') AS win_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'loss') AS loss_count
  FROM player_results
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, pc.win_count, pc.loss_count
FROM player_counts pc
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pc.player_api_id
WHERE pc.loss_count >= 107
ORDER BY pc.loss_count DESC
